• Races

ok so I honestly don't know that much about it but I'll do my best

if these stat differences actual exist (I'm more or less sure they do and these are the right ones) they're pretty negligible and with a good playstyle any race can work well with any class

there are four Races in PSO2

-Human -human, all rounder. have good HP, and either good S-ATK and S-DEF or T-ATK and T-DEF, depending on gender, with no particularly low stats. They are geared towards the hunter and fighter class.

-Cast - cool robots I think the female ones are also called Seal, they have better defense but less energy for casting spells and using weapon techniques. have good HP, S-ATK, R-ATK, and DEX, and either good S-DEF or R-DEF, depending on gender, but low T-ATK and T-DEF. They are geared towards the ranger and gunner classes.

-Numan -genetically modified humans they look like elves, they have less defense and health but have the most energy for spells and skills. they have good T-ATK, and either good R-DEF or T-DEF, depending on gender, but low HP and DEX. They are geared towards the force and techer classes.

-Duman -these guys are new to me but they're humans with demon horn(s) and have dichromatic eyes so they look cool I think they have more attack than most but less defense. have good S-ATK, R-ATK, and T-ATK, but low HP. They are geared towards the braver class.

but any race can use any class and any weapon so it's mostly cosmetic differences and also what they can wear

  • Classes

I've only ever used one class and one subclass but I'll do my best to explain this

there's 8 classes

every class can use the gunslash which switches between a sword and a gun and has decent tech attk for spells and there are cross class weapons I'll explain all the weapons in another post

all the classes are mostly dps the close range classes are as close as you get to tank

-Hunter close range slower but heavier damage I think. uses sword, wired lance, and partizan

-Fighter close range faster. uses twin dagger, double spear, and knuckles

-Ranger long range heavy damage basically sniper this is the class with weak bullet I think which is a super important ability. I believe rangers also have access to traps. uses assault rifle and launcher

-Gunner long range faster evasive enough to use guns at close range. uses assault rifle and twin machine guns

-Force power focused mage use this if you want to use magic for damage. uses rod and talis

-Techer support focused mage use this if you want to be a healer. uses wand and talis

-Braver special class for all range fighting. switches between katana and bullet bow

-Bouncer special class for stat support use this if you wanna play support or be a mage knight. uses jet boots and dual blade

  • Weapons

I haven't used most of the weapons so this is just going to be the cliff notes

-Gunslash the jack of all trades weapon has decent stats for spell casting and works as both a gun and a sword with skills that use it as both at the same time it's a cool weapon but the class specific weapons are usually much better so it doesn't get much use

-Sword the basic hunter weapon nothing wrong with the classics I've seen plenty of people use this well

-Wired Lances the tricky hunter weapon has all kinds of weird moves to control enemies and move yourself around

-Partizan the other hunter weapon it's a spear it seems good but I personally haven't noticed it used a lot

-Twin Dagger the basic fighter weapon think dual sword in monster hunter it's fast and gets lots of hits but is a little weak in exchange

-Double Saber the tricky fighter weapon be darth maul sounds pretty cool to me never tried it tho be darth maul if you want

-Knuckles the fun fighter weapon BOXING IS COOL! jab, jab, straight right, uppercut! it's pretty fun

-Assault Rifle the basic gun both long range classes can use it nothing special but very reliable

-Launcher the power ranger weapon somewhere between a missile launcher and a laser cannon slow but a lot of power

-Twin Machine gun the cool gunner weapon it's fast and you do all kinds of backflips and shit while using it think twin uzis from some action movie

-talis the weird magic weapon both magic classes can use it and it's my personal favorite it's weird you throw cards that hover in place and then you can fire your spells out of the cards in any direction wiht a bonus to their power it's a fun idea and good for a more tactical approach

-Rod the basic force weapon great for power casting has some weird trick where you can store spells in it or something and you can wack enemies who get too close

-Wand the magical girl techer weapon weirdly good it's very effective from the support role but with certain skills it can function as a good close range weapon to a certain extent

-Katana the close range braver weapon be a samurai with a laser sword have fun

-Bulllet Bow the long range braver weapon be a samurai with a laser bow and arrow have fun

-Jet Boots the fun Bouncer weapon fly around and give out power ups cast spells by kicking

-Dual Blade the mage knight Bouncer weapon cast and fight and dodge around

there are also weapon camos you can equip to make all of a certain weapon equipped on your character look a certain way

PS: it's important to note that there are cross class versions of all the weapons because equipping is based on stats
